objective: Prove or refute that complete ordinary payments make all remaining local observations at the same holder functions of its first payment, including any allowed source-only changes. Relate this to the joint probability of rereads.
status: Proved for every ordinary continuation. A fixed receiver with all marks paid has a constant local record under either law, including wordwise lawful motions confined to the original disjoint sender pair. Scientific referee pending.
title: Which local histories can a fixed holder acquire after payment?
